name: CoolIT Systems
description: Calgary direct-liquid-cooling specialist: coolant distribution units, coldplates, coldplate loops and rack manifolds. Acquired by KKR in 2023; Ecolab announced an agreement in March 2026 to buy it from KKR funds for about $4.75 billion in cash.
notes: Ecolab's release announces an agreement, not completion; no page read confirms the deal closed.
